tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Tracked apps of the user, 20 per page by default. Use nextOffset for more.

tools.name: add_app
tools.description: Track an app by App Store ID; its name is looked up automatically. Omit appStoreId (and pass name) for a temporary app. Free plan: 1 app.

tools.name: add_keywords
tools.description: Track up to 100 keywords for an app in a store and measure rank, popularity and difficulty. Plan limit on total tracked keywords (free: 10); a batch over the limit is rejected entirely.

tools.name: refresh_app_keywords
tools.description: Measure all tracked keywords of an app now and append to history.

tools.name: get_app_keywords
tools.description: Tracked keywords of an app with latest metrics, 20 per page by default. Use nextOffset for more.

tools.name: get_keyword_history
tools.description: Daily rank, popularity and difficulty history of one tracked keyword (keywordId from get_app_keywords), oldest first; days without measurements are omitted. Free plan: last 7 days. Defaults to 30 points per page; use nextOffset for more.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current plan, tracked apps, keywords and research calls in the current quota period (free: month, pro: day). A null limit means unlimited.

tools.name: search_app_store
tools.description: Live App Store search for a keyword. Returns ranked apps and difficulty. With appStoreId, ranking is computed from all totalApps results, independently of limit; null means not found in those results. metadataIncomplete counts returned apps whose details are unavailable. Counts toward the research q

tools.name: get_keyword_popularity
tools.description: Popularity scores for up to 100 keywords in a store, without tracking them. Counts toward the research quota.

tools.name: get_keyword_metrics
tools.description: Popularity and difficulty for up to 20 keywords in one call, without tracking them. Popularity is per store, difficulty per store and platform. Counts toward the research quota.

tools.name: get_keyword_suggestions
tools.description: Keyword ideas for an App Store app with popularity and difficulty for the selected platform. Counts toward the research quota. Defaults to 20 keywords (max 100). Use nextOffset for more; null means the last page. Each page counts as a research call: pass limit: 100 to get everything in one call. Cur

tools.name: get_most_searched_keywords
tools.description: One page of the most searched keywords in a store, optionally for an App Store category id (e.g. 6013). Check `month`: data can be from an earlier month. Counts toward the research quota. Defaults to 20 keywords per page (max 100).

tools.name: get_competitor_keywords
tools.description: Derives 1–3 word candidates from the top 10 competitors ranking for a keyword and returns those with popularity > 5, highest first. Pass your appStoreId to exclude your own app. Counts toward the research quota. Defaults to 20 keywords (max 100). Use nextOffset for more; null means the last page. Ea

tools.name: get_app_details
tools.description: App listing summaries for up to 50 IDs; unavailable apps are omitted. Descriptions and screenshot URLs are excluded unless includeDescription/includeScreenshots is true. No icon URLs. Counts toward the research quota.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_apps" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
